misc.text: “Possible The Parallels Oda Using For The Ring & Eyes Behind Imu” I think I might of cracked the actual representation of the ring of eyes behind imu yall!!! 1. Starting with the ring, we know one of the many inspos is angel called Ophanim. But in Buddhism, it’s called Nenku / Zakkou (Head Halo) & it’s also flame one called Kashoku (Flame Halo). 2. Now for eyes parallel. There is the yokai called Dodomeki, the 100 bird eye arm! Lately we have been connecting “Imu Is A Parrot” that’s a bird. The Japanese folklore about the Dodomeki, is very greedy & represented by word call Chomoku, said to be define as COPPER COINS & right now Imu is fighting Scopper. 3. Last, the Dodomeki with the eyes of greed, truly loves actual material wealth & said to consume & devour material possessions. We know The 19 celestials family heirlooms are material possessions!!! That could mean consume them. But wait the Dodomeki is said to consume life force & SOULS!!!! This being what imu done to them, consume their. Souls & material possessions. Imu really like a damn demon pirate!! That’s it for this. Drop yall opinions.
